user.title: Add e-ink device
user.description: Start the E-Ink Dashboard app on the e-reader. It shows its IP address and a pairing code.

pair.title: Pair e-ink device
pair.description: Enter the pairing code shown on the device ({host}).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the device. Is the app running and the IP address correct?
error.already_paired: The device is already paired. Unpair it on the device first (hold the status bar for 5 seconds).

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.
abort.ssl_not_supported: Home Assistant uses HTTPS directly. Old e-readers only support plain HTTP inside the local network.
abort.already_paired_elsewhere: The device is paired with another Home Assistant. Unpair it on the device first.

data_description.dashboard: Which dashboard the device shows. Tip: create a separate dashboard with a few large buttons.
